source.note_posted_date_basis: note title suffix 261124 interpreted as 2026-11-24 Asia/Shanghai; unverified against platform timestamp

capture_method.readback: User profile loaded in a logged-in RunningCheeseChrome browser (huashu-chrome CDP bridge; initial NO_EXTENSION cleared after browser launch + retry); card metadata extracted from DOM (section.note-item). IMPORTANT: first DOM read returned a CACHED stale list whose newest ranking was 261123; page reload exposed the true newest note 261124 (cover signature timestamp 202611250905). Always reload before selecting latest note.
capture_method.ocr_preprocessing: cover upscaled 3x with ffmpeg lanczos (640x323 -> 1920x969), then cropped into left/right halves and per-row slices at 2x-4x for glyph disambiguation
capture_method.ocr_uncertainty_note: Book/author names transcribed from a low-resolution embedded table. Ambiguous glyphs flagged medium with per-item ocr_notes (e.g. 黏/粘, 妩/姝, 橘, 嫌凝/嫌疑, 祈/析); no glyph resolved by guessing. Qualitative label '好坏参半性转嫌疑' transcribed verbatim despite odd semantics.
capture_method.danping_column_absent: This cover has only 7 columns (排名/发表时间/标签题材/书名/作者名/喜欢/评论现状); there is NO 弹评 column. Schema requires danping, so danping is left as empty string for all rows — NOT an OCR omission, NOT zero, NOT fabricated. Differs from 261123 cover which did include a 弹评 numeric column.

parsing.ranking_scope: single screenshot of one daily ranking table; not the full platform ranking
parsing.column_semantics_note: likes is the numeric count as printed under '喜欢'; danping is empty because the source cover has no 弹评 column (see capture_method.danping_column_absent); comment_status is a qualitative label under '评论现状'.
parsing.tags_normalization: original '.' separators rendered as '/' in CSV for readability

analysis_boundary: Single-cover OCR of a third-party public ranking screenshot. Book/author names and counts are best-effort transcription from an embedded low-resolution table, not verified against the original platform; several glyphs flagged medium remain ambiguous. This cover lacks a 弹评 column entirely; danping is deliberately empty rather than guessed. Qualitative comment_status is the screenshot author's label, not measured data. Do not treat as official ranking or as read book text. No full text of any work is stored.
